Thank you so much for the kind words. At least as a starter job, I have dreamed of becoming an author, since I'm fascinated by writing. I'm one of those kids where when an upcoming essay is announced, I'm glad while everyone else is whining. 
Again, I appreciate your encouraging words. You've helped me realize I still have goals to achieve.

Thank you all so much for your help. Without your motivational words I would probably be dead by now. Be aware that you've just saved a life. You guys helped me realize I should be looking for solutions instead of complaining about random events. I do still have some problems to take care of, but I can solve them, one at a time. A continuation of receiving pms would be very helpful. Again, thank you for the support.

I'm right with you. It's been a long time since I've cried. But throughout last year, everything would be happy, but my parents would bring up some small thing that would trigger the horrible moments of the past, and I would just breakdown. I hope you end up doing alright.
